title: MLINE-referenced simple LTYPE with signed-long XDATA

scope.source: Runtime-generated LTYPE and APPID records; no repository drawing fixture is used or added.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.linetype: EditDash, two simple dash segments [1.0, -0.5], declared length 1.5, source flags 0, alignment 65.

authority.document: DXF Group Codes in Numerical Order Reference
authority.relevant_rule: XDATA group 1071 is a signed 32-bit integer. This receipt tests the signed value -123456789 only.

proof.source: Physical source fields and fresh import verify the 1001 APPID followed by typed 1071 value -123456789. Import-time origin, raw/typed equality, the AppIdName role and APPID name lookup bind the provider.
proof.output: The staged output proof checks exact 1001/1071 order and numeric value, APPID row common fields/flags/emitted owner and fresh typed readback of the signed integer.
proof.failure_retry: Removing the source APPID provider refuses export and preserves the destination sentinel; restoring it succeeds on the same adapter. A late APPID-name mutation also refuses atomically and succeeds after correction on the same adapter.

limits: This receipt qualifies one AC1027 simple-LTYPE XDATA application with exactly one signed 1071 value of -123456789 and one bare source-bound APPID provider. It does not qualify other 1071 values, other XDATA scalar types/values, 1003/1005 dependency resolution, 1004 binary data, coordinate tuples, mixed payload schemas, broader APPID metadata, other LTYPE schemas or versions.
The receipt establishes transport only. It does not establish application-specific XDATA meaning, MLINE rendering, recursive document closure, or broader LTYPE provider support.
